ingest.note: Audio sent back to the PSTN caller must be G.711 μ-law 8 kHz.

egress.note: Inbound caller audio arrives as G.711 μ-law 8 kHz mono over the Call Control media stream.

potholes.note: Telephony audio is narrowband μ-law 8 kHz. A decode and resample stage is mandatory before any model.
Media streams are tied to a call_control_id; use it to correlate WebSocket frames with call lifecycle events.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Stop sending audio frames to the Call Control media stream. Telnyx media socket does not support explicit clear.
interruption.code_hint: On interruption: stop writing to the WebSocket and flush your local outbound buffer.
